description: A man in a khaki bush hat and khaki shirt kneels on dry, sandy scrubland beside thorn trees, shaking a round metal sieve filled with small reddish-brown grains. Behind him a green vintage Land Rover with a canvas top and jerry cans is parked. Cloth sacks, a hand trowel, a hammer and a magnifying loupe lie on the ground. No visible text. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with a tiny green mark in the bottom-right corner.
